test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In this question, the statement is followed by four conclusions. Find out which conclusion is NOT true based on the given statement.

Statement: C > N = R ≥ H > Q < S
solution:
Given Statement: C > N = R ≥ H > Q Conclusions:

Option 1: N ≥ H → True (N = R ≥ H It gives N ≥ H)

Option 2: S > Q → True (Q It gives S > Q)

Option 3: C > R → True (C > N = R It gives C > R)

Option 4: C ≥ H → False (C > N = R ≥ H It gives C > H)

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
